description.text: There are courses of 6 grades for 3 levels available namely preliminary level ,intermediate level and senior level. Preliminary level includes grade 1, grade 2 and grade 3 affording Comprehensive , Oral and listening courses. Intermediate level includes grade 4 and grade 5 affording Comprehensive ,Oral ,listening and Reading courses. Senior level includes grade 6 affording Comprehensive, Oral, Listening, Audio-visual, and Newspaper reading courses. There are two tests in every semester. The general score is made up of the score of mid-term examination ,final examination and comprehensive evaluation which account for 30%,40%amd 30% separately. In addition, mid-term examination paper and final examination paper are to be designed in hundred-mark system.

duration.text: The Chinese Language Training Program at Beijing University of Technology is a 4 Months long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1152 USD/In total ￥ 8300 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.

requirements.text: Applicants should be healthy both mentally and physically; 2. Applicants should hold foreign passport and be above 18 years old
